environment.description: Same Celery worker on ECS Fargate in private subnet. The upload API is fronted by an ALB associated with an AWS WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL includes the AWS managed rule group 'AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet' with all rules in default action (BLOCK), which includes the rule 'ExploitablePaths_URIPATH' and critically the rule 'Host_localhost_HEADER' and general bad-input signatures. Additionally, a custom WAFv2 rule with priority 1 uses a RegexPatternSet matching '<!ENTITY|<!DOCTYPE.*\[|SYSTEM\s+["\']' on the request body field (with body size limit set to 64KB via oversized handling 'MATCH'), action BLOCK. The WebACL body inspection is configured with 'SizeInspectionLimit' of 64KB. The Fargate task's security group restricts all egress to only the DynamoDB VPC endpoint and the Redis endpoint (no NAT gateway route, no internet egress). The task execution role has an explicit deny on ec2:CreateNetworkInterface to prevent attachment of additional ENIs.
